links.outcome: Readability of LLM EMDR psychoeducation responses versus recommended patient education levels
links.effect: All evaluated models produced responses exceeding commonly recommended readability levels for patient education materials; DeepSeek was most readable.
links.quote: All the evaluated models produced responses that exceeded the commonly recommended readability levels for patient education materials.

screen.reason: Evaluated the informational quality (EQIP) and readability of three LLMs (GPT-4o, Gemini 1.5 Pro, DeepSeek V3) answering psychoeducational questions about EMDR without testing any specific guardrail or deployment practice.
